extracted.name: Ginger Crinkles
extracted.description: This is a recipe from my mother. Our family has been making them for 50 years.
instruction_lines: Mix oil and sugar thoroughly with electric mixer. Add egg and mix well. Pour in molasses. Sift and add dry ingredients until incorporated.
Roll teaspoonful of dough into ball, drop into sugar to coat.
Place on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 350 degrees F (175 degrees C) for 15 minutes.
